changelog:
scientific-figure-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of a complete scientific figure analysis pipeline.
- Automates extraction and interpretation of figures from scientific PDFs using PyMuPDF, Kimi K2.6 vision AI, and scientific reasoning.
- Supports detection, segmentation, and classification of complex figure panels with high-fidelity metadata retention.
- Enables structured knowledge extraction, reverse engineering of visualization workflows, and research automation.
- Adapts to vision/model/API limitations with fallback strategies, ensuring robust operation.
summary: 科学论文图表完整分析流水线 — PDF图表提取(PyMuPDF) + Kimi K2.6多模态视觉分析 + 科学理解 + 逆向工程。 触发场景: (1) 分析论文PDF中的图表，(2) 逆向工程图表生成流水线，(3) 从文献中提取结构化知识，(4) 论文自动化文献挖掘。 Do NOT call: 纯文本阅读、非科...
